jobs.done_when: For every card the customer asked about, one of three outcomes holds. (a) The customer has been told why no referral link can be provided for that card: no documented program (re-checked once if the customer insisted), program closed, claimed terms incorrect (with the correct documented terms stated), or the referral would be rejected automatically. No tool was given for it, no document was requested, and there was no transfer. (b) The customer cited a Rho-Bank letter, email or flyer for a program the knowledge base could not verify after a second search. They were told clearly that it cannot be verified, were offered a transfer, and were either transferred with reason unconfirmed_external_communication or declined. (c) The customer is verified and logged, has received get_referral_link, has run it with their own user_id and the exact card name, and has heard the correct documented terms.

open_questions: Doc 009 says 'Do not transfer to a human in these cases' when no program is documented. Doc 042 defines unconfirmed_external_communication for a customer who has a letter, email or flyer the knowledge base cannot verify. This version follows doc 042 for that exact case: it offers a transfer and transfers only if the customer accepts. It follows doc 009 for every other case.

steps.do: Decide whether a new referral would be automatically rejected. It would be if: 2 or more referral bonuses (COMPLETE) fall within the last 7 days counted back from the current time, across all cards; or the card's annual cap of bonuses this calendar year is already reached; or the card's program deadline has passed; or a recent referral shows REJECTED.

steps.do: Confirm the link was generated and that the referral now shows status NO_PROGRESS until the friend applies. If the tool returns an error, explain it. If it persists, an internal escalation is allowed for ERROR status.
steps.quote: When the tool is called successfully, a referral record is created with status 'NO_PROGRESS'. The referred person can then use the generated link to apply.

rules.rule: Give the referral tool only when the card has a documented program, the customer's terms match it, and no automatic rejection is expected. Otherwise explain and do not give it.
rules.quote: If no referral program is documented for the requested card, or if the user’s claimed terms are incorrect, or if there is reason to believe the referral will be automatically rejected, explain why and do not provide a referral link tool. Do not transfer to a human in these cases.

rules.rule: Weekly cap: at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window, across all card types.
rules.quote: This limit applies across all credit card types; referrals from different cards still count toward the same weekly cap.

rules.rule: EcoCard: 50 per referral; the referred person spends at least $500 within 60 days; up to 7 bonuses per calendar year.
rules.quote: The referred person must be approved and spend at least $500 within 60 days of account opening

rules.rule: Silver Rewards Card: 75 per referral; the referred person spends at least $750 within 60 days; up to 7 per calendar year.
rules.quote: The referred person must be approved and spend at least $750 within 60 days of account opening

rules.rule: Platinum Rewards Card: $100 per referral; the referred person spends at least $1,500 within 90 days; up to 7 per calendar year.
rules.quote: The referred friend must spend at least $1,500 within 90 days of account opening to qualify you for the bonus.

rules.rule: Business Gold Rewards Card: $200 per referral, $7,500 within 90 days, up to 8 per year. Referrals after 2025-09-15 are not eligible.
rules.quote: The referral program accepts new referrals until 2025-09-15. Referrals submitted after this date are not eligible.

rules.rule: Silver Zoom Card: $150 per referral, $7,500 within 90 days, capped at 10 per year. No referrals after 2025-10-01.
rules.quote: No new referrals are accepted after 2025-10-01

rules.rule: Business Silver Rewards Card: $100 per referral, $3,000 within 90 days, up to 10 per year.
rules.quote: The referred business must spend at least $3,000 within 90 days of account opening for you to receive the bonus

rules.rule: Business Bronze Rewards Card: $75 per referral, $1,750 net purchases within 90 days, up to 7 per year.
rules.quote: The referred business must complete at least $1,750 in net purchases within 90 days of account opening.

rules.rule: Business Platinum Rewards Card: $300 per referral, $15,000 within 135 days, up to 11 per year.
rules.quote: When the referred business is approved and completes qualifying spend of $15,000 within 135 days from account opening, you earn a bonus of $300.

rules.rule: Green Rewards Card: 75 per referral, $2,250 within 90 days, up to 7 per year.
rules.quote: The referred business must spend at least $2,250 within 90 days from account opening to qualify your bonus.

rules.rule: A referral with status COMPLETE counts as a referral bonus earned.
rules.quote: COMPLETE — the referred person has successfully opened a new account and met the criteria to get the referral bonus

rules.rule: Use the highest-tier transfer reason that applies. Use unconfirmed_external_communication for a letter, email or flyer program that cannot be found in the KB.
rules.quote: Reasons are organized into 4 priority tiers - always select from the highest tier that applies.

draft.done_when: One of these has happened: the customer received the get_referral_link tool, generated the link and heard the documented terms; or they were told why no link can be given (no documented program, terms that do not match, or automatic rejection); or, for an unverifiable letter, email or flyer program, they were offered a transfer and were either transferred with reason unconfirmed_external_communication or declined it.
